description.zh: 经典拍翅飞行：一下一下点出节奏，从水管缝里挤过去。越飞越快、缝隙越来越窄，看看你能撑到第几根管子。
description.en: The classic one-tap flyer. Flap through the pipe gaps — it gets faster and tighter the further you go. How many pipes can you clear?

controls.zh: 点击 / 空格 / ↑ 拍翅，Esc / P 暂停；触屏点屏幕或按「拍翅」按钮
controls.en: Click / Space / Up to flap, Esc / P to pause; tap the screen or the Flap button on touch devices
